entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these absolutely awful shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable!

I can certainly look into that for you. I understand you're frustrated. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

A preference? No! These are your most expensive cycling shoes! I spent an hour installing my cleats, went for one single ride, and they gave me the worst blisters I've ever had. They're defective! I want a full refund, and I want it now. If I don't get it, I'm lighting you up on every review site and forum I can find. Get me a manager!

I understand your frustration, and there's no need for a manager. I can handle this for you directly. Getting blisters on a first ride sounds like a terrible experience, and I'm very sorry that happened. Let me just pull up your order information.
You better. I'm not paying for shoes that shred my feet.

Okay, I have your order here. I see you purchased the Pro-Road cycling shoes, and they were delivered just six days ago. Because this is a standard item and you're well within the 90-day return window, I can absolutely process a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Oh. It's... it's within 90 days? So you'll take them back even though I've worn them and put the cleats on?

Yes, absolutely. Our policy covers that. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. Just print it out, box up the shoes, and drop them off at any postal service location. Once we receive them, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
Okay. Well... that's... that's good. That's what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can find a better footwear solution for you in the future. Have a great day.
